adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the service now always performs a refresh-token request during initialization (`fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token"...)`) and throws on any non-OK response (`if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw ...`). There is no check of the existing stored `access_token`/expiry before forcing a refresh, so a transient refresh failure will prevent constructing/using the Salesforce connection even if the previously stored access token might still be valid.
